_doc: A-render-r1 #10 re-shoot with diagnostics (silt k, lens clear, cloud shell, camera alt): natural warning, then the god flood, town view 600 m.

shots.name: r1c-flood-before
script: window.__diag = () => { try { const R = window.__GENESIS_R__; const cu = R.clouds.material.uniforms; const vis = window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.vis; const vu = vis.uniforms; const cb = vis.camBody; const Rp = vis.pv.params.radius; const st = vis.pv.settlements.find((s) => s.id === window.__sid); return { siltK: [...vu.uSiltK.value].map((x) => +x.toFixed(3)), silt: vu.uSilt.value.map((v) => [v.x, v.y, v.z, v.w].map(Math.round)), lens: [Math.round(cu.uLensClear.value.x), +cu.uLensClear.value.y.toFixed(3)], camFog: cu.uCamFog.value, shell: [cu.uShell.value.x - Rp, cu.uShell.value.y - Rp].map(Math.round), alt: Math.round(cb.length() - Rp), town: st && st.pos.map((x) => Math.round(x * Rp)) }; } catch (e) { return String(e); } };
G.hold('ui'); G.toastLife(600000); document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); const p = G.poi('river'); window.__riv = p;
const r0 = await G.cmd({ k: 'life.spawn-people', species: 'plains-folk', count: 60, era: 'bronze', settled: true, wildGame: false, pos: p.pos });
const sid = r0.created?.find((e) => e.kind === 'settlement')?.id; window.__sid = sid; await G.step(1440*3);
G.hold(false); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: { kind: 'settlement', id: sid }, dist: 600, tilt: 60, yaw: 20, fov: 50, hour: 11 }); await G.frames(8); G.hold('ui');
return { poi: p && [p.lat, p.lon], r0: JSON.stringify(r0).slice(0, 300) };

shots.name: r1c-flood-warning
script: const sid = window.__sid; const pv = () => window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.vis.pv; const pos = () => pv().settlements.find((s) => s.id === sid)?.pos;
await G.cmd({ k: 'set', path: 'disasters.natural', value: 4 }); let d = null, days = 0, hours = 0;

for (days = 0; days < 40 && !d; days++) { if (days % 2 === 0) await G.cmd({ k: 'water.rain', pos: [...pos()], radius: 2500, duration: 2880, intensity: 3 }); for (let h = 0; h < 24 && !d; h++) { await G.step(60); d = pv().disasters.find((x) => x.kind === 'flood' && x.params && x.params.warning); } }
G.hold(false); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: { kind: 'settlement', id: sid }, dist: 600, tilt: 60, yaw: 20, fov: 50, hour: 11 }); await G.frames(10); G.hold('ui');
const all = pv().disasters.map((x) => ({ k: x.kind, id: x.id, p: x.params })); const ev = await G.query('settlement', { id: sid });

return { diag: __diag(), days, flood: d && { id: d.id, params: d.params, god: d.god, cause: d.cause }, all, toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.gn-toast')].map((t) => t.innerText).slice(0,6), evac: JSON.stringify(ev).match(/evac[^,]*,[^,]*/g) };

shots.name: r1c-flood-home
script: await G.cmd({ k: 'set', path: 'disasters.natural', value: 0 }); await G.step(1440*4); G.hold(false); await G.frames(10); G.hold('ui');

shots.name: r1c-flood-god
script: const st = window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.vis.pv.settlements.find((s) => s.id === window.__sid); const r = await G.freeform('flood ' + st.name); await G.step(90);
G.hold(false); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: { kind: 'settlement', id: window.__sid }, dist: 600, tilt: 60, yaw: 20, fov: 50, hour: 11 }); await G.frames(10); G.hold('ui');

return { diag: __diag(), r: JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 400), all: window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.vis.pv.disasters.map((x) => ({ k: x.kind, p: x.params })), toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.gn-toast')].map((t) => t.innerText).slice(0,6) };
